config.design: 12 months and8 numbers x next/previous/copy x4 forms =240 prompts. Next/previous matched token length and exactly one changed instruction token. Same inputs, candidate sets shared per domain. Four spaced discovery items per domain, remaining items transfer. Explicit cyclic month and arithmetic number answers frozen before inference.
config.limitations: Familiar inputs and repeated next-month templates, new controlled operation comparison; not entirely unseen-data replication. Single-token next-token accuracy only, shared candidate accuracy remains weaker than generation.
